title: Evaluation via Supervised Machine Learning of the Broiler Pectoralis Major and Liver Transcriptome in Association With the Muscle Myopathy Wooden Breast
summary: Supervised transcriptome SVM and MLP models distinguish broilers with wooden-breast myopathy and identify differential-expression regulators, with five-fold cross-validation and a separate held-out split reported. The result is a disease-associated transcriptomic signature, not causal validation of the regulators.
